main_text.l: Quas quum stare diu & valere credit-

l.i: Virtus vera non est, vbi gloria quaritur.

main_text.l: Curte nil dixi veræ virtutis habere-
Non placitura Deo, reliquis aut commoda
curas:Gloria, quicquid agis, quæritur vna tibi.
Ipsa sibi merces virtus est vna: satelles-
Pulcher erat Dauid formâ linguáque difertus,
Laudis puncta simul retulit illa duo.
ardor:Hæc laudum dici maxima iure potest.
Dum latrat catulus, morsu non lædit at anguis,
Qui tacito virus proiicit ore, necat.
Sic est occulti discrimen & hostis apertis:
Hic terret; sensim sed parit ille necem.

page.notes: Marginal marks on the left are decorative blots/ink marks, not text. Some words are faint or show-through from the reverse page and were read with care; "Hellas" and "Oenanthen" as printed. Line breaks within verse stanzas are shown with br for clarity.
